annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于印发《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》的通知
annotation.title_en: State Council Notice on Issuing the 15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: China State Council's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) for agricultural and rural modernization. It covers food security, poverty prevention, rural revitalization and green transition. Embodied-AI content is limited to promoting intelligent farm machinery, low-altitude economy in agriculture, and agricultural AI and smart farming development.
key_provisions_or_claims: Promote high-end intelligent farm machinery suited to hilly areas and new-energy agricultural machinery.
Orderly develop the low-altitude economy in agriculture and rural areas.
Accelerate agricultural AI innovation, application scenarios, and multimodal datasets and standards.
Build an integrated sky-air-ground agricultural observation network.
Targets for 2030 and 2035: agricultural modernization and strong agricultural nation.
